See below for products. In this series I’ll teach you my approach to skincare, we’re starting basic and building from there. I’ll give product recs, but it’s really about explaining why each step is there, not just selling you products. SUNSCREEN • EltaMD UV Clear: my go to starter sunscreen. Great formulation, contains niacinamide • Supergoop Unseen: a favorite for the guys • Colorescience Sunforgettable: tinted, great if you want a makeup effect • ISDIN Eryfotona: for when you want serious protection, all mineral CLEANSER Most people don’t need to cleanse in the morning. Water is often enough. Otherwise keep it simple (aka cheap) • Cetaphil, CeraVe Cream to Foam, or La Roche Posay Purifying Foaming Cleanser all work great • Wearing makeup? Cleanse twice or start with a cleansing balm RETINOL Over the counter is a great place to start but this is one category that I think warrants a convo with your derm to see if prescription strength tretinoin (/altreno/arazlo/etc) is right for you. Or if you have really sensitive rosacea prone skin, talk to a derm about maybe dropping the retinol For starting out: • Neutrogena Retinol Pro, Avène Retrinal, SkinBetter Alpha Ret MOISTURIZER A healthy barrier means less irritation and smoother skin • Prequel AM/PM, Dieux Instant Angel, or Vanicream Moisturizing Cream are all versatile picks that work for most skin types Next video we start the advanced routine! #skincare #dermatologist
